messages:
maria: Requesting an unpin of runtime v2.3 for the YA-GG-1.2 model rollout. The model requires a newer kernel selection path that's currently blocked by the pinned runtime. Can we schedule an unpin in the next change window?

deploy-bot: @maria noted. Please include rollback steps and confirm SDK compatibility. Change window availability: 09:00-11:00 UTC tomorrow or 02:00-04:00 UTC the day after.

tom: I can follow up on the runtime side. Quick note: unpinning runtime globally will let the scheduler pick kernel v2.4 for that model, which fixes the attention caching bug. Need to ensure we don't break legacy quantized paths.

kevin: Confirming model YA-GG-1.2 has been validated on runtime v2.4 in perf cluster. Primary risk is older SDK clients that depend on the legacy KV ordering API. We should pin the SDK contract or provide a compatibility shim.

sarah: Product prefers the earliest window (tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC) to meet customer timelines. We need short release notes: what changed, affected models, and guidance for SDK upgrades.

josh: Oncall OK for tomorrow. Rollback plan: 1) revert runtime pin to v2.3 via rollout API 2) force-model-variant to ya-gg-1.1 for customers on pinned SDK 3) monitor p95 latency and error-rate for 30m. If any metric >2x baseline, trigger rollback.

maria: Adding suggested config diff for the unpin (apply via infra-config tool):

```
# before
runtime_pin: "2.3"
# after
runtime_pin: null  # allow auto-selection
model_overrides:
  YA-GG-1.2:
    max_seq: 4096
    kernel_hint: "v2.4"
```

kevin: We'll also ship a small SDK warning on v1.4 and earlier: calls that rely on kv-order may get different results. Recommend SDK users upgrade to v1.5+ or set runtime_compat: legacy_kv. I'll draft the text for release notes.

tom: Ops checklist: 
- deploy dry-run in staging at 06:00 UTC tomorrow
- enable canary to 5% traffic for 15m
- health probes on kv-cache hit ratio and token latency
- feature flag to force runtime_pin if rollback needed

release-bot: Release note draft pushed: https://internal.redwood/relnotes/ya-gg-1.2-runtime-unpin-1732504321 

sarah: Nice. Make sure the note includes the SDK compatibility snippet and the two-step rollback instructions. Also add a line for customers using dedicated pools (they might need manual pool update).

maria: I'll own the rollout and monitoring dashboard. Plan: start staging dry-run 06:00, change window tomorrow 09:15 UTC, canary 5% -> 50% over 45m -> full. If anything exceeds thresholds, execute Josh's rollback plan.

josh: I'll be on pager and will trigger rollback if p95 token latency > 1.8x baseline or error rate spike > 0.2%.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change: 2024-06-10 09:15 UTC in change window. Automation jobs queued. Remember to update the dedicated-pools doc if customers request manual pin.

maria: Thanks all — proceeding with staging dry-run. Will post results. :rocket:

release-bot: Staging dry-run completed at 06:18 UTC. Canary metrics: p50 latency +3%, p95 +7%, error-rate steady. No regressions observed. Can proceed to change window.

maria: Starting canary at 09:15 UTC -> 5% traffic now. Monitoring dashboards up.

josh: Canary steady at 5% for 15m, moving to 25% now.

kevin: Observed slight tokenizer mismatch warnings for a small subset (~0.02%). Those are within threshold but I'll monitor.

maria: Increasing to 50% at 09:42 UTC. No alerts.

josh: Full rollout started at 09:58 UTC. Will watch metrics for 30m.

release-bot: Rollout complete at 10:11 UTC. Runtime unpin applied and YA-GG-1.2 served on kernel v2.4.

maria: Post-rollout note: no customer-facing regressions reported, small tokenizer mismatch warnings logged and triaged to kevin. I'll open a follow-up task to add the SDK shim for legacy_kv.

kevin: Created task INF-4217 to implement runtime_compat flag and SDK shim.

sarah: Adding short customer-facing blurb to release notes and sending to comms.

maria: Closing thread — thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
